This interaction may contribute to the therapeutic effects observed in Huntington Disease-like Syndrome due to C9orf72 expansions, though the direct mechanism linking these compounds to the disease remains unclear. The evidence suggests a possible role in neurochemical regulation, but further investigation is needed to establish a causal relationship. The presence of a synergistic interaction implies that the compounds may work in concert to modulate pathways relevant to the disease, though the specific molecular mechanisms require additional validation.
